notes.title: FRISIA Demo Update 0.0.16 - Settle, explore, discover!
notes.notes:
It is time fellow settlers! I am happy to announce that as of today the new Update 0.0.16 is live!
With this update there will be sailable ships, new buildings and new gameplay mechanics arriving! Let's take a short dive into the new stuff!

The Map
First, let's talk about the new map! I have completely reworked how the world is set up. You have now much more smaller islands. Trees are scarce, you will probably have to rely on other source of harvesting wood! To settle on an island you now have to claim it first. You can do this via a cute little flagpost, situated near every islands dock! 

Old Savegames
Since the way the game is played changes quite drastically, I have decided to remove the previous map from the game. Therefore your old savegames sadly won't work anymore. I will move the current state of the game to another branch, so if you would like to access your old savegames, you can downgrade your version. You can do so by right clicking Frisia Demo in your library and selecting the "Beta"-Tab. There you can choose the version "0.0,15" and select it. Not that this version is the old state of the game and does neither include the new feature nor will be able to load your new savegames!

New Mechanic: Fog
With Update 0.0.16 the whole map is covered in dense fog. You will have to explore the map by ship, activate buoys and place lighthouses to permanently uncover the map, Which brings us to the next major addition of the patch:

Ships!
You are now able to sail your very own little ship. You will need it to strive through the dense fog and uncover the islands who are ready for settlement around the map. But be aware: your ship can run aground if you are cought by the ebb at the wrong place. No need to worry though, as the next flood will free your ship and you will be ready to go once again. Don't forget, that you can customize your ship in terms of colors!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787659/f92c7163a3b5962d77db82aa674f12a17c37b3c6.png
New Buildings
Now to the last big addition, the new buildings. Since most of the new islands don't host any trees you will need a new primary woodsource. For that I have added the Driftwood Collector! This building will passively generate wood without needing a forest nearby. It works much slower than a lumbercamp though.

Another new building is the new Simple Hut. It gets unlocked before the house that is currently in the game. It's comparibly cheaper but hosts less workers.

To keep your villagers fed, you can supply them now with a new ressource: mussels. You can gather them with the new Beach Fishing Hut. This building needs to be placed in the tidal flats, so you will have to wait for the ebb to place it.

Last but not least, our lighthouse gets a tiny litte friend: the Crossmarkfire. This unique maritime building uncovers a smaller amount of the map than the lighthouse, but is also much cheaper.

Various additions
Another part I have poured a significant amount of time into, is overhauling the UI. I increased the readability by changing the font, I changed the look and added new juicy animations! Let me know what you think.

As always I would be happy if you share your thoughts in the forum. If you stumble across technical issues also let me know in the Forum dedicated for bugs. Since I am a Solo-Dev every help is greatly appreciated.

The future
I would like to conclude this announcement with a small amount of info about the future: I am currently reworking the game in all of its mechanics, to keep the scope and development timeframe realistic. For that I am going back to the drawing board. I hope I can give some more details on the FRISIA will be moving in the following weeks!
Thanks for the input from all the people around me and especially you, the players who tried out the demo so far. I was able to get FRISIA to a point I could never have hoped for! So thank you all, I am really excited for the future and would be happy to have you follow me on my way there!

With that, happy settling, strong winds und immer 'ne Handbreit Wasser unter'm Kiel!* ;)

Best wishes
Rouven

*(and always a hand's breadth of water under the keel)

notes.title: NEWS: Upcoming Update 0.0.16
notes.notes:
Ahoi everyone!

Gamescom is over and I am glad to announce the content of the next upcoming demo update.
Some things have been shown at Gamescom, so some of you may have already an impression, but there will be a lot more that was not showcased!

I am currently uncertain how much time it will take to polish the update, since it will turn the game pretty much into a new one, so I want to take my time with it. 

New Mechanic: Ships!
Previously the ships you could find on the map had no purpose. This changes with the next update. Players will be given a ship which they can use to travel the map and find islands to settle on! Set your course and be on your merry way towards new adventures!

New Mechanic: Fog of War
The map in the next update will be completely covered in fog. You will have to sail your ship through this fog and find beacons who permanently uncover the map. 

Lighthouses now also have a purpose: they provide a huge area in which they uncover the map permanently. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787659/d8850fac47668e0307a42799fe8b8fc9204f8547.png
UI Overhaul
As you may have seen from the previous screenshot, the User Interface got a complete rework. I have improved the readability by switching to a new font, added a new color scheme together with some juicy animations to improve the gamefeel. 

The Tide-Display was also reworked and is now permanently visible and indicates the waterlevel and current tide status. There was also a minimap added to provide you with better orientation.

Map Rework
Speaking of orientation: the map also got a complete rework. It now consists of many much smaller islands. Forests are quite rare and you have to manage your space more carefully. Islands have to be approached by ship and then be claimed to be unlocked for building. 

Sadly your current saves won't work in combination with this map overhaul, since it completely changes how the game is played and how different systems interact. But the new map system gives me the ability to avoid this in the future and make changes or additions to the map more easily. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787659/6682c00a6fccfddc298e22476e18983d515a1b4f.png
New Buildings
There are also some new buildings and production chains planned, to give you more content to play with and build more cozy, frisian towns!

That's it!  
(for now...) I am really excited for this one and will keep you updated about what's to come!

notes.title: NEWS: Funding, Gamescom and subsequent update Info (0.0.15)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
There hasn’t been a lot of info from my side lately, which is why I’d like to get back to you with a fresh announcement, because a lot has happened in the past months.

First of all I’d like to subsequently drop some info on the last update from spring, 0.0.15: (its not a lot, just for the sake of completeness)

 New system for placing fences 
 Minor Bug fixes


With that off the table, let’s get to the more exciting news!

Funding
I am very happy to announce, that I received some funding from the Gamecity Hamburg, in the form of their “Games Lift Incubator”-Program. With this I am able to lay down a solid foundation for the further development of Frisia, which makes me very happy! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787659/1ea234db03177a9fec72729d428ca2fb64fe7b58.png

Gamescom
I will also attend the Gamescom in Cologne, DE, this year as part of a combined program, of three universities from germany in which my current university is a part of! So if you want to meet up, I will be at the "Home of Indies” booth in the Indie Area, on Friday, August 23 approximately from 9:00 AM until 1:00 PM! 

Coming updates
For the purpose of Gamescom, I’ve been working on a few updates, mainly interface improvements and onboarding. But there are also new exciting features, which I will hopefully get to share with you in the coming week! 

Until then. stay cozy everyone!

notes.title: Update 0.0.14 - Overhauled Color-Customization System and new Look!
notes.notes:
With this Update Frisia gets a completely overhauled Color-Customizer alongside with a few changes to the visual appearance.

The new color customizer gives full control to the players. You are now able to choose the colors for your buildings completely free with the new color wheel. There is also now an option to copy the color scheme from one building to another, saving you a lot of time when trying to get the same colors for different buildings. 

The general visual appearance was also slightly changed to bit more vibrant and less gritty look. 

Bugfixes:
- Fixed bug where in the main menu the currently selected language would only appear after refreshing the settings menu
- Fixed Typos and grammatical errors

notes.title: Update 0.0.13 - New Building & New Road System
notes.notes:
This Update adds a completely overhauled Road Building System, which should feel much more natural than the previous one.

It also adds an new building: the church. This building can be unlocked by finding the sunken church and aquiring its ancient church bell. The church will sound its bells, whenever the flood is setting in. 

Bug-Fixes:
- Fixed an issue where the camera could be moved when the game was paused
- Fixed an issue where unlock-messages were not dissapearing when the pause menu was opened

notes.title: Update 0.0.12 - Unlock system and Tutorial
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! This is the first bigger update for Demo of Frisia. 

The Update added a much needed unlock aka progression system, which will allow you to unlock buildings and production chains progressively. You can unlock buildings by discovering all the ressources needed for the construction.

Alongside i added a small Tutorial, that should cover the most basic mechanics of the game. A much more in-depth tutorial is planned for the future. 

Bugfixes and other changes:
- Fixed a bug where the closing of building infos where not working properly
- Adjusted the duration of tide intervals
- Added addittional spawnpoints for flotsome (beached crates)
- Grouped spawnable items close to beached ships to make the more of a point of interest
- Removed requirement of one worker to collect beached materials
